# gramlot-examples 0.3.38 — shorter gallery navigation

Requires gramlot 0.3.31.

- The navigation root has ten groups: eight tutorial groups followed by database demos and real-time, server and AI demos. Groups are defined in `groups.json` and assigned by `_family.json`; lesson keys stay unchanged.
- No folder holds a single entry: after environment and filter, a folder with one entry is replaced by that entry, in the Python and JavaScript galleries.
- The filter menu is a labelled "Show" selector above the logo, distinct from the search field.
- New Real-time family: streaming sine waves, microphone spectrum (both browser only) and the psutil system monitor (Python server; the hosted image installs the `system-monitor` extra).
- The two database grid lessons are one lesson, "Grid on a database query", with the grid in the page and no timing figures; the Asqueel selectors lesson adds `dbComboBox`.
- Families can be marked `"public": false`; the hosted galleries leave out the transfer experiments and the customers-across-adapters page.

Qualification: gallery, navigation, filter, catalog and structure tests, and the deploy tests, passed; the complete suite was not run for this release.
